name: Michelle Lopes Maldonado
office: Member of the Virginia House of Delegates until 31 May 2026
stance: Sponsor of Virginia's high-risk AI (algorithmic discrimination) bill vetoed in 2025 and of a 2026 chatbot child-safety bill continued to 2027. Resigned her seat on 31 May 2026 to join the Information Technology and Innovation Foundation as an AI policy analyst.

statements.text: What I'm suggesting is that we don't wait to see how it evolves. That we'd be engaged in a very thoughtful conversation from the start.
Her 2026 bill barring chatbots from manipulating children toward self-harm was continued to 2027.

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
